purpose: Additive non-Mundarica source-discovery records verified from publisher or institutional repository metadata. These records are discovery leads only unless separately canonicalized and evidence-linked; cultural assertions remain source-reported and scope-bounded.

records.title: Religion as everyday resistance: Birsaite Dharam in contemporary Jharkhand
records.author: publisher metadata verified; author list requires full bibliographic capture before canonicalization
records.notes: Publisher abstract is now accessible and verifies a contemporary Jharkhand study of Birsaite Dharam based on fieldwork. The abstract describes continuity, adaptation, collective identity and everyday resistance among Birsaites. Register only as a contemporary religion/politics/identity source lead. No theological, political, territorial, historical or community-wide proposition is promoted without exact passage, method/sample, participant context, contradiction/variant review and community-aware cultural-access assessment.
records.rights_note: Publisher abstract visibility does not establish full-text redistribution, participant-data reuse, image/table reuse, commercial reuse or community authorization. Fieldwork-derived and religious material requires separate consent/cultural-access review.

records.title: Adivasi women’s movements in eastern India: south Bihar and Jharkhand since the 1980s
records.publisher: Sapienza Università di Roma institutional doctoral repository
records.author: Marilena Proietti
records.notes: Institutional repository metadata verifies a 2025 doctoral thesis examining Adivasi women's movements in eastern India from the 1980s onward, explicitly including Oraon, Munda, Santal and Ho communities. A second Sapienza record independently confirms the thesis and open-access file. MLHKP promotes only this comparative source scope, not Munda-specific findings.
records.rights_note: Repository open access and Creative Commons metadata do not override third-party/participant material, consent, dignity or MLHKP cultural-access restrictions. Comparative Adivasi evidence is not automatically Munda-specific evidence.

canonicalization.decision: Exact title/author/year and two institutional repository records match; registered once as a standalone audited MMSC identity and not double-counted in the discovery layer.
